snippet.title: Your Camp is Your Home in Oppidum – Build, Upgrade & Survive!
snippet.description:
Oppidum is a co-op survival adventure where your camp is the heart of your journey. Build, upgrade, and decorate your base as you explore the mysterious island of Insule. Play solo or with up to 3 friends in this story-driven survival experience.

🚀 Coming in Q1 2025 to Steam, PlayStation, Xbox (and later on to Nintendo Switch).

WHAT'S IN THIS VIDEO?
- How camp-building works in Oppidum
- How to upgrade structures and unlock new crafting options
- What decorations you can use to personalize your camp
- A first look at co-op base-building gameplay

FEATURES OF OPPIDUM
· BUILD & UPGRADE – Unlock blueprints, improve structures, and expand your camp
· CO-OP ADVENTURE – Play solo or with up to 3 friends in online multiplayer
· SURVIVE & FIGHT – Defend yourself against enemies while gathering resources
· CUSTOMIZE WITH DECORATIONS – Furnish your camp with torches, fences, tables, flower pots, and more
· CRAFT, FARM & COOK – Grow crops, prepare muffins, and sustain yourself
